investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: plain curl GET (descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser) of the venue's official homepage and its own 'VORSCHAU' (preview/upcoming) programme page, plus its robots.txt. The site is a deliberately minimal, hand-written HTML4 page (no CMS, no JS framework, no client-rendered shell to potentially escalate against) whose entire 'programme' is a single static poster image, not machine-readable text — a genuine, honestly-observed dead end for automated acquisition, not an under-investigated one.

probe_history.reason: The venue's own former domain (aboutparty.net) redirects (HTTP 301) to its current official domain, aboutblank.li, whose homepage is a ~1.8KB hand-written, plain HTML4 page with a handful of links and no CMS/framework fingerprint (no wp-json, no application/ld+json, no window.__NUXT__/__NEXT_DATA__, no known calendar plugin). Its own 'VORSCHAU' (German: preview/upcoming) link at /next/ — the closest thing to a programme page this site offers — contains no event text at all: the entire visible 'programme' is one embedded static JPEG poster image (current.jpg, confirmed via a HEAD request: Content-Type: image/jpeg). There is no client-side JS bootstrap, page-data blob, or discoverable endpoint to inspect at all — this is not a client-rendered SPA hiding a JSON API, it is a genuinely static, deliberately minimal, image-only page. No dates, titles, lineups, or any other event field exists anywhere as text.

identity.notes: aboutparty.net (independently corroborated as the venue's known domain by multiple third-party discovery sources — Berlin.de, visitBerlin.de, RA — treated only as a discovery lead) issues a live HTTP 301 redirect to aboutblank.li, whose own retained page content (og:title '://about blank', links to the venue's own Bandcamp 'aboutblankberlin' and SoundCloud 'about-blank-berlin' accounts) is first-party evidence this is genuinely the same venue's current official domain, not a lookalike or unrelated site.

site_classification.platform: No CMS or framework detected — a deliberately minimal, hand-written plain HTML4 page (matches this club's well-documented anti-marketing, DIY culture). No JSON-LD, ICS, WordPress, Fourvenues, or Sanity signature found anywhere.

title.notes: The site's entire programme is one static poster image; no event title text exists anywhere in the retained HTML.

start_date.notes: No date text exists anywhere in the retained HTML — a human would need to read the poster image itself, which this framework does not OCR or otherwise interpret as structured fact.

venue_location.notes: Not stated per-event anywhere; the site never repeats its own address on the programme page.

source_record_id.notes: No per-event identifier or permalink of any kind exists — the whole site has only a handful of static pages (/next/, /sektgarten, /feiern, /faq), none per-event.

event_url.notes: There is no per-event URL — /next/ is the one static page covering whatever is currently on the poster.

blockers.description: The site's entire event 'programme' is a single static poster image with no accompanying machine-readable text anywhere — no JSON-LD, ICS, API, CMS, or even a plain-text event list. There is nothing here a text-based, non-OCR collector could parse, matching this club's well-documented anti-marketing culture.

reasons: Level 1 (PASSIVE_STATIC) genuinely exposed no machine-readable event data of any kind — confirmed by direct inspection, not assumed.

The site is a deliberately minimal, hand-written HTML4 page with no CMS/framework at all — there is no client-rendered shell, JS bootstrap, or bootstrap data blob to plausibly hide a discoverable endpoint behind, so a Level 2 STRUCTURAL escalation would not change this conclusion; escalating further would not be a genuine attempt to find something, only motion for its own sake.

Per docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md, DEFER does not require exhausting the escalation ladder, and is the correct, honest outcome for a club that has deliberately chosen not to publish machine-readable event data — not a gap to be papered over by guessing at the poster image's contents.
